TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms its intent to comply with the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, C&W Department and KPPRA Rules 2014 requirements for the Rehabilitation and Widening of 64 km District Roads Package-IV (including three bridges) within the 24‑month period and two monsoon seasons as stated in the RFP.

For mandatory bid submission requirements, we will submit the bid to the Office of the Superintending Engineer, C&W, Circle, Peshawar in sealed envelopes under the single stage one envelope procedure as required (KPPRA Rules 2014) and will provide bid security of PKR 37 million (2%) in the form of a CDR or bank guarantee; we have an established bank guarantee facility of PKR 100 million and can arrange CDR/bank guarantees from scheduled banks within this limit. [CO-PROFILE]

We will submit a detailed construction methodology and a CPM-based work program demonstrating completion within 24 months, including monsoon constraints, and we will align HSE execution to our documented HSE policy and our zero reportable fatality record. [CO-PROFILE]

Partial/Gaps and closure actions:
- PEC registration (C‑A/C‑1): our library confirms we do not hold PEC constructor registration in category C‑A/C‑1. [CO-PROFILE] We will address this mandatory gap through a compliant JV/consortium partner holding the required PEC category and specialization, with roles and liabilities defined in the JV agreement.
- Experience thresholds (three road contracts ≥ PKR 700M): our evidenced road projects are PKR 142–199M and do not meet the PKR 700M threshold. [CAP-015][CAP-039][CAP-003][CAP-027] We will meet this requirement via the same compliant JV partner(s), while we contribute delivery systems and project controls.
- Turnover (≥ PKR 1,500M): our average annual turnover evidenced is PKR 900M over three audited years. [CO-PROFILE] We will satisfy this through JV aggregation with audited statements from the lead partner.
- ISO 14001: our fact sheet confirms ISO 14001 is not held. [CO-PROFILE] We will include an ISO 14001–certified environmental management partner/subcontractor for works in the protected watershed zone.

For bridge capability, our evidence includes bridge engineering deployments up to PKR 200M; however, span lengths are not evidenced in our records. [CAP-028] We will therefore rely on the lead/JV bridge contractor’s span-qualified references and nominate an experienced Bridge Engineer accordingly.
